title: MCP Server Security Scanner input
description: Point the scanner at a Model Context Protocol server, or paste its tools/list response directly.

mcpUrl.title: MCP server URL
mcpUrl.description: The Streamable-HTTP endpoint of the MCP server to audit, e.g. https://example.com/mcp . The scanner performs the standard initialize + tools/list handshake and scores every advertised tool. Leave blank if you are supplying toolsJson instead.

toolsJson.title: tools/list JSON (optional)
toolsJson.description: Optional. Paste a raw MCP tools/list result (an object with a tools[] array, or the bare array) to audit tools you already captured — fully offline, no network call to the target. Takes precedence over mcpUrl.

failOn.title: Fail the run on verdict
failOn.description: Exit with a non-zero status when the worst verdict reaches this level — useful when wiring the Actor into a CI gate. 'never' always exits clean.
